mediaWork.title: The Wrong Carlos: Anatomy of a Wrongful Execution
mediaWork.creatorName: James S. Liebman and the Columbia DeLuna Project
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Wrongful execution, criminal justice system failures, death penalty critique, mistaken identity
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This book details a six-year investigation into the wrongful execution of Carlos DeLuna.  It presents a meticulous compilation of evidence, including police and court files, crime scene photos, audiotapes, and witness interviews, to argue DeLuna's innocence. The book serves as both a case study and a critique of the US death penalty system, highlighting how systemic failures can lead to irreversible injustice.
